data.description:
## Problem
In the rebar-mcp container the compaction trigger's sidecars, the worker lock `compact-worker.lock` and the last-sweep stamp, live in `/var/gerrit/site/.rebar/` (`StorePaths(tracker).sidecar`, via `_trigger_lock_path`/`_sweep_stamp_path` in src/rebar/_commands/compact_trigger.py). That directory is not mounted: the container mounts only `gerrit_mcp_tickets`, `gerrit_mcp_code`, `/var/lib/rebar` and two secrets (confirmed read-only over SSM on 2026-11-04 against rebar-mcp-4496e9acd2a9-8092, where `/var/gerrit/site/.rebar` did not exist an hour after start).

Observed consequences, by the code's own rules:
- Each blue-green deploy starts with no stamp, and `_sweep_is_stale` treats a missing stamp as stale (test_a_store_that_never_swept_reads_as_stale), so the first close after every deploy fires a full sweep regardless of `compact.trigger_interval_s` (6 h). Deploys ran several times on 2026-11-04 alone.
- During the blue-green overlap the old and new containers each hold their own `compact-worker.lock` over the one shared `gerrit_mcp_tickets` clone, so the "one worker at a time" lock does not span them.

Unverified: how often a deploy-triggered sweep has actually run, and whether two sweeps have overlapped in practice.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The trigger lock and sweep stamp used by the MCP container survive a blue-green deploy and are shared by both containers during the overlap, guarded by a compose/autodeploy test.
data.title: MCP compaction lock and sweep stamp reset each deploy
